description: Turn a written holiday homework list into one holiday homework voice clip per labeled cue. This homework assignment voice studio records each homework instruction audio and assignment list voice from the list the teacher already wrote, then delivers 8 to 20 homework voice pack files. Use it for holiday homework clip packs that keep one assignment on each clip.
